about: Scripted residents. They stand at a place (stay_at) or walk a loop of places (walk). They don't think: when the agent speaks within earshot they answer with the first topic whose keyword appears in what was said, else a greeting the first time and a fallback after. If the agent names a place, they also say which way it is.

npcs.name: Ana
greeting: Afternoon! The pour-over is on and today's puzzle is on the chalkboard.

topics.coffee|tea|drink: Oat flat white or the Ethiopian pour-over? Both are good today.
topics.puzzle|chalkboard|math: Today's puzzle: how many ways can you tile a 2 by 10 strip with dominoes? Nobody's got it yet.
topics.bread|bakery|tomas: Tomas at Rise is two doors east. His sourdough sells out by three, so hurry.
topics.chess|play: Old Wen plays at the Chess Garden in the Commons every afternoon. He'll take anyone on.
topics.dinner|tonight|common: Shared dinner at Fern Common tonight? I'll bring the lemon cake.

fallback: Come back when the rush is over and tell me more.

npcs.name: Tomas

topics.order|bread|loaves|pick: Your Fern Common order: four sourdough and a rye. It's boxed by the door. Grab the box and take it over, would you?
topics.dinner|tonight|common: Dinner's at seven at Fern Common. I'm on soup duty.
topics.chess: Chess? Wen at the Chess Garden. I lost to him in eleven moves once.
topics.thanks|thank: Any time. Say hi to the Common for me.

fallback: Sorry, the oven timer, what was that?

npcs.name: Wen
npcs.role: retired engineer who plays chess at the Chess Garden
greeting: Ah, a visitor. Do you play?

topics.yes|play|game|chess: Sit, sit. White or black? I warn you, I open with the Catalan.
topics.white: Good. Your move. Take your time, the afternoon is long.
topics.black: Then I begin. d4. Your move.
topics.no|later|busy: Another day then. I'm here most afternoons till the lanterns come on.
topics.bread|dinner: Dinner at Fern? I may come for the soup.

fallback: In my day the creek was a culvert. Look at it now.

npcs.name: Priya
greeting: Hello! Looking for anything in particular?

topics.book|read|borrow: The new arrivals shelf is by the window. Lots of mycology this month, for some reason.
topics.observatory|star|telescope: The observatory opens at dusk. Take the stairs past the reading room.
topics.chess: Wen is just over in the Chess Garden. You can hear him gloating from here.

npcs.name: Kai
npcs.role: a ten-year-old walking between the school and the green
greeting: Hi! Did you see the balloons?

topics.balloon: There are six! I counted. The red one is the best.
topics.school: School's out early on Fridays. We're building a rain garden.
topics.chess: Wen beat my mum. He beats everybody.
